= GitHub Actions

This file describes how the workflows in `.github/workflows/` behave today.
It does not change those workflows.
A Claude mention is text a maintainer writes to ask Claude to run.
Codex reviews pull requests on its own.

Every job runs on `ubuntu-latest`.
Continuous Integration uses Node `22.x`, Node `24.x`, and Node `26.x`.
Any other job that installs dependencies uses Node `26.x`.
Claude jobs read the `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` secret and commit through the GitHub API.
Publish signs in to npm with GitHub's OIDC token.

== Overview

A pull request runs Continuous Integration.
A push to `main` or to a `vX.Y.x` branch runs it too.

Renovate opens one pull request for each dependency.
Dependency Review may add one follow-up commit to that pull request.
Codex reviews the Renovate pull request, and it reviews a pull request Claude opened for an issue.
Codex Review asks Claude to fix open findings for two rounds.
On the third round the workflow only reports what is still open.
Every hour, the watchdog flags a pull request in that loop whose latest commit Codex has not reviewed for two hours.

A Claude mention or the `claude` label starts Claude for work that is not a release.
On an issue, Claude opens a branch named `claude-issue-<number>-...` and a pull request that is ready for review.

A release starts as an open issue titled `Release @perfective/build vX.Y.Z`.
Adding the `claude` label starts Publish PR instead of the general Claude workflow.
Claude opens a pull request titled `Publish vX.Y.Z` from the branch `publish-vX.Y.Z`.
The maintainer squash-merges that pull request, signs the tag, and pushes the tag.
Publish then publishes the package to npm.
The maintainer creates the GitHub Release by hand.

== ci.yaml

Continuous Integration runs on a push to `main`, on a push to a `vX.Y.x` branch, and on every pull request.
Each Node version runs `npm ci`, then `npm run lint:build`, then `npm run dist`.
The job does not run tests, because this repository has no test script.

== dependency-review.yaml

Dependency Review runs when Renovate opens, reopens, or updates a pull request that Renovate authored.
A maintainer starts that review again by adding the `claude-review` label.
Claude follows the `update-dependency` skill and may push one signed follow-up commit.
A successful run starts Codex Review again.

== claude.yaml

Claude runs when a maintainer writes a Claude mention or adds the `claude` label.
A release issue and a Publish pull request are left to Publish PR.
For an issue, Claude opens the branch `claude-issue-<number>-...` and a pull request.
A later mention on that pull request keeps working on the same branch.
A later mention on the issue does not commit, because an issue run checks out `main`.
Claude and Codex Review share the lock `claude-<number>`, so only one of them pushes at a time.

== codex-review.yaml

Codex Review runs when Codex posts or edits its summary on a Renovate pull request.
It also runs for a pull request that Claude opened for an issue, and after Dependency Review succeeds.
Publish pull requests stay with the maintainer.
Claude fixes open findings for two rounds.
The third round is only reported.
A failed review, or a summary this workflow cannot read, adds the `help wanted` label.

== codex-watchdog.yaml

Codex Review Watchdog runs every hour, and a maintainer can run it by hand.
It checks open Renovate pull requests and pull requests Claude opened for an issue.
When the latest commit is at least two hours old and Codex has not reviewed it, the job comments once.
It adds `help wanted` for that commit.

== publish-pr.yaml

Publish PR runs when a maintainer adds the `claude` label to an open issue titled `Release @perfective/build vX.Y.Z`.
It also runs when a maintainer writes a Claude mention on the Publish pull request.
The job stops when that version's tag already exists, or when the Publish pull request is already merged.
An existing `publish-vX.Y.Z` branch is continued.
Claude commits one change titled `Publish vX.Y.Z`.
That commit may include only the version, the lockfile, the changelog, the READMEs, and the roadmap.
This workflow does not create the tag, and it does not publish to npm.

== publish.yaml

Publish runs when a tag matching `v*` is pushed.
npm trusted publishing is bound to the file name `publish.yaml`.
The tag must be annotated, GitHub must verify its signature, and the commit must be on `main` or on `vX.Y.x`.
`package.json` must carry that version, and `CHANGELOG.adoc` must contain a section for it.
The job runs `lint:build` and `dist`, then publishes `./dist` with provenance.
A release on `main` uses the dist-tag `latest`.
A release on a backport branch uses `backport-X.Y`.
A prerelease uses `next`.
This workflow does not create a GitHub Release.

== Renovate

`renovate.json` makes Renovate open one pull request per dependency and leave it for a maintainer to merge.
`rangeStrategy` is `bump`, so the version pin in `package.json` moves together with the lockfile.
A major update, a peer dependency update, and a TypeScript update receive the `help wanted` label.
The label `renovate-regenerate` tells Renovate to recreate the branch.
This repository has no Dependabot configuration and no `CODEOWNERS` file.
